surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 Sao Paulo GP preview: asphalt grip 3/5, asphalt abrasion 2/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 3, braking 3, lateral 3, tyre stress 3, track evolution 5, downforce 4.

source.notes: Projected, 12 m wide, scaled to 4,309 m. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along br-1940 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m, scaled to the published 43.0 m highest to lowest, its steepest stretch drawn to the published 10%.
